question: Should maintainers rebase this maintainer-labeled awaited process-cleanup PR onto current main and proceed after exact-head checks, or pause it?
rationale: The code path and proof support the fix, but the protected label and dirty merge state require a human to own the conflict resolution and final landing decision.

options.title: Rebase and proceed
